subject: Renewal and Dedicated Expansion — tokens/sec addendum & SLO language (SentryFlow)
messages:
From: Aaron Klein <aaron.k@sentryflow.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@sentryflow.com
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + Dedicated expansion — need tokens/sec guarantee for new pool

Hi Soojin,

We’re finalizing our FY28 budget and want to expand the Dedicated pool as part of our renewal. Current ask: add 8 additional A100-equivalent GPUs to our reserved pool and include an explicit tokens/sec commitment for peak throughput (we run a mix of chat + embedding workloads, peak bursts during ETL windows).

High-level asks: 
- Start date aligned with renewal (2027-07-15)
- Tokens/sec target: proposal from Redwood? We can share logs if needed.
- SLA / credits language if tokens/sec not met during the committed window

Can you share an addendum draft and an estimate for incremental monthly spend (with any term-discounting for a 12‑month commit)? Procurement is on copy and will need the doc + PO-ready pricing.

Thanks — appreciate a quick turnaround this week.

Aaron
Aaron Klein
Head of Platform Ops, SentryFlow
aaron.k@sentryflow.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, procurement@sentryflow.com
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + Dedicated expansion — need tokens/sec guarantee for new pool

Aaron — thanks for the clear ask. We can definitely support adding 8 A100-equivalent GPUs and bake the tokens/sec commitment into an addendum. I’ve attached an initial draft for SentryFlow (see sentryflow_tokensps_addendum_v3.pdf) that:

- Specifies a dedicated pool increase of +8 GPUs effective 2027-07-15
- Proposes a committed steady-state of 45k tokens/sec with 90k tokens/sec burst capability (with a 2x burst allowance for 5-minute windows)
- Defines SLO measurement windows, sampling cadence (1m averages), and the credits ladder for under-performance

Marissa (cc’d) will confirm commercial pricing/discounts; Neha, can you validate the tokens/sec targets and add any recommended fallback/fanout policies so we’re operationally safe?

Next steps I suggest: 
1) Neha to confirm technical targets and whether 45k/90k is appropriate given their current traffic profile.
2) Marissa to provide PO-ready pricing and term options for a 12-month commit.
3) We iterate SLO language if procurement needs edits; aim to sign by 2027-07-08 to meet July 15 start.

Uploading the addendum and the throughput table — will update after internal review.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior AM, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Aaron Klein <aaron.k@sentryflow.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, procurement@sentryflow.com
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + Dedicated expansion — need tokens/sec guarantee for new pool

Aaron / Soojin — I pulled a short MAAP-style table (attached SentryFlow_MAAP_table.csv) from the logs you shared earlier and ran a capacity projection. Quick notes: 

- Based on SentryFlow’s 90th percentile QPS/seq-length mix, 8 A100-equivalents maps to ~48k sustained tokens/sec with our current quantization profile.
- For safety we recommend a committed steady-state of 40–45k tokens/sec and allow a burst to 88–95k for up to 5 minutes every hour with automatic fallback to a compatible quantized variant if sustained utilization > 95% for a 10-minute window.
- Measurement: we sample KV-cache aware token issuance at 1-minute intervals; SLO compliance is calculated as the percentage of 1-minute windows in the billing period where observed tokens/sec >= committed threshold.

Suggested SLO clause language (short): 
"Committed Throughput: Redwood commits to providing a dedicated pool with a sustained tokens/sec throughput of 45,000 (\"Committed Throughput\") and a burst capability up to 90,000 tokens/sec for 5-minute windows. Compliance is measured using 1-minute sampling windows across the Customer pool. If ≥ 95% of sampling windows in a billing month meet the Committed Throughput, Redwood is deemed in compliance. Failure to meet the Committed Throughput will result in service credits per the schedule in Section X."

I also recommend adding an operational fallback paragraph that describes automatic model variant fallback and notification cadence (immediate alert + 15-minute remediation window). Happy to refine wording in the PDF.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Principal Inference Engineer, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

Aaron — pricing summary for the +8 A100-equivalent GPU expansion and 12-month commitment: 

- Incremental list: $46,000/month (GPU + reserved infra)
- Standard 12-month term discount applied: 12% => $40,480/month
- Tokens/sec SLA addendum (45k sustained / 90k burst) is included in the above price; additional support package (4h response SLA, 24/7 on-call) available for +$6,000/month.

Commercial ask: if SentryFlow signs by 2027-07-08 we can lock in the 12% term pricing and schedule the capacity to be live on 2027-07-15. Legal: please review SLO credit schedule in Section X of the attached addendum.

If procurement is comfortable, I can generate a PO-ready quote and attach a DocuSign envelope for signature.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole

From: Aaron Klein <aaron.k@sentryflow.com>

Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + Dedicated expansion — need tokens/sec guarantee for new pool

Team — appreciate the fast turnaround and the draft addendum. Two small asks before we sign: 
1) We need the SLO credit ladder to be explicit in dollar terms (example: 5% credit for month if compliance 90–95%, 15% if compliance 80–90%, etc.). The current PDF references a schedule but it isn’t spelled out.
2) We want an escalation contact + 30-minute phone page for production-impacting throughput violations (during business hours) — can Redwood commit to a named on-call role for the first 30 days after go-live?

If those two items are in the final doc, procurement can sign and send the PO. Can you put the final DocuSign link on the thread when ready?

Aaron
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Aaron Klein <aaron.k@sentryflow@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, procurement@sentryflow.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + Dedicated expansion — need tokens/sec guarantee for new pool

Aaron — thanks, good points. We updated the addendum to include an explicit dollar-denominated credit ladder and an on-call escalation clause. Highlights of the update: 

- Credit ladder now included in Section X (example values): 5% monthly credit for 90–95% compliance; 15% for 80–90%; 30% for <80%. Credits apply to the monthly dedicated pool charge only.
- On-call escalation: Redwood will provide a named escalation contact with 30-minute phone page response during standard business hours for the first 30 days following go-live; extended 24/7 escalation is available with the premium support add-on.
- DocuSign envelope: https://docusign.com/embedded/sf-addendum-2027 (live; we’ll attach the updated PDF and the PO-ready quote).

We’re aiming to have everything signed by 2027-07-08 to make the 2027-07-15 start. Please confirm and procurement can route the PO.

Looking forward to getting SentryFlow scaled up.

— Soojin
